reviews.text:
Clay Bistro by Chef Sandeep is a hidden gem. Situated in The Arcade in Brigade Orchards, Devanhalli. Chef Sandeep has a great understanding of food and flavours which is very evident in the spread that is served. Butter Chicken, Mutton Biryani, Pasta, Nachos, Soya Chaap (the list is long...) are simply outstanding. He goes to great length in supporting and customising house parties too. Food is served fresh(piping hot), as per your pallette with all the support and condiments that one may need. What impresses me is the probing he does beforehand and the inputs that he gives to decide the menu or make perfect combinations.

Kudos to him and the team...!

owner_response.text:
Thank you so much Amit Bhise for your thoughtful review and kind words about Clay Bistro and Chef Sandeep! We’re delighted to hear how much you enjoyed the flavors and variety in our dishes. Chef Sandeep takes pride in tailoring each dining experience to match individual preferences, so it’s wonderful to know that attention to detail stood out to you. Our team strives to bring freshly prepared dishes and seamless service to every table and event. We’re thrilled you felt well-supported, and we look forward to making your next visit just as memorable. Many thanks from all of us!
Best regards 
Clay bistro's team

reviews.text:
"Cozy Haven with Delicious Food!

Clay Bistro is a hidden gem in Bengaluru. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with rustic-chic decor and a lovely outdoor seating area. The food is a fusion of Indian and international flavors, with dishes that are both familiar and innovative.

Try the clay oven pizzas and pasta dishes - they're delicious! Friendly service and reasonable prices make it an excellent value.

Rating breakdown:

- Food: 5/5
- Ambiance: 5/5
- Service: 5/5
- Value: 5/5

Recommended!"

owner_response.text:
Thank you so much, Chetan, for your kind words and detailed review! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your time at Clay Bistro and appreciated the fusion of Indian and international flavors we offer. It's great to know that our cozy atmosphere and outdoor seating added to your dining experience. We’re glad the clay oven pizzas and pasta stood out for you! 

We look forward to welcoming you back soon for more delicious meals. Thanks again for the recommendation!
Best regards 
Clay Bistro Team
